requirements.title: Create the label scheme before the first step
requirements.rationale: A session that files an issue with a label that does not exist loses the label, or the issue.

criteria.condition: `specrun` starts a run that is not a dry run
criteria.action: create every label of the scheme before the first step: `af:awaits`, `af:defect`, `af:untested`, `af:deviation`, `af:severity-security`, `af:severity-data-loss`, `af:severity-correctness`, `af:severity-minor`, `af:accepted`, `af:rejected`, `af:repair-failed`, and `af:from-<NN>` and `af:awaits-<NN>` for every package under the spec root and its archive
criteria.contract: each label exists on the forge before the first session starts; a label that exists already is left as it is and is not an error

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go (new): with packages 01 and 02 and an archived 00, and a forge that already has af:defect: run one step; assert the forge holds the 11 fixed labels and af:from-00, af:awaits-00, af:from-01, af:awaits-01, af:from-02, af:awaits-02; assert every CreateLabel call came before the session started; assert the conflict on af:defect raised no error and no warning

criteria.condition: no forge client can be made: no token is configured, the repository has no origin remote, or the forge is not supported
criteria.contract: exit code 1; `error.stage` is `preflight` and the message names `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN` and `GITLAB_TOKEN`, or the remote; no session started and nothing written to a forge

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go, a table over {no token in the environment, no origin remote}: assert exit code 1, error.stage == 'preflight', the fake claude never started

criteria.action: make no write to the forge, and go on with a warning when no forge client can be made
criteria.contract: the forge records no `CreateLabel`, `AddLabels`, `RemoveLabel` or `AddComment` call; without a client `warnings` holds one `forge_unavailable` entry and the dry run still names the next step

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go, a table over {a forge client, none}: run --dry-run; assert exit code 0 and result.next_step; assert the in-memory forge recorded no write; assert codes(warnings) == ['forge_unavailable'] in the second case

requirements.title: Check the labels of the issues a landed package opened
requirements.rationale: The rules that follow filter on labels; an issue without them is invisible to every one of them.

criteria.condition: a package has landed and each of its open issues carries exactly one kind label, `af:from-<NN>`, one severity when it is a `defect` and one `af:awaits-<MM>` when it is `awaits`
criteria.action: leave the issues as they are
criteria.contract: the forge records no write for them

criteria.condition: a package has landed and an open issue of it, found by its label `af:from-<NN>` or by a title that starts with `<NN_name>:`, lacks a kind, lacks `af:from-<NN>`, is a `defect` without a severity, or is `awaits` without `af:awaits-<MM>`
criteria.action: make `af:deviation` its only kind label, add `af:from-<NN>` when it lacks it, and comment on it
criteria.contract: after the step the issue carries `af:deviation`, no other kind label and `af:from-<NN>`; one comment names the rule `incomplete-labels`, what was missing and the commit of the base branch; an issue of another package and a closed issue are not touched

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go, a table over the open issues the fake session leaves for package 01: {complete defect with severity -> no write; complete awaits -> no write; no label at all, title '01_name: x' -> af:deviation + af:from-01 + comment; af:defect, af:from-01, no severity -> af:deviation, af:defect removed, comment; af:awaits, af:from-01, no af:awaits-MM -> af:deviation, af:awaits removed; two kinds -> af:deviation only; title '02_name: y' -> no write; a closed issue of 01 without labels -> no write}: assert the labels of each afterwards and that each comment contains 'incomplete-labels' and rev-parse(main)

criteria.action: for any issue the rule has already changed, change nothing when the rule runs again
criteria.contract: a second run over the same issues records no forge write

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go: apply the rule of REQ-2.2 twice to the table's issues: assert the second application records no AddLabels, RemoveLabel or AddComment call

criteria.condition: a forge call of the rule fails
criteria.contract: exit code 1; `result.stopped.reason` names the rule and the forge's error; the package's ledger line is written with outcome `landed`; no further session starts; the next start applies the rule again before choosing a step

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/labels_test.go: with the in-memory forge failing AddLabels once: assert exit code 1, the reason contains 'incomplete-labels', the ledger's last outcome is 'landed' and package 02's session did not start; run again: assert the issue is relabelled and 02's session starts

requirements.title: Read the AF-Run trailer into the ledger
requirements.rationale: A count parsed from prose is wrong the first time the prose changes.

criteria.condition: a package has landed and its merge commit ends with an `AF-Run:` trailer holding one JSON object
criteria.action: put the trailer's `gate` and `open_items` objects into the package's ledger line, and its full gate runs and seconds, reused gates and opened items into the short form
criteria.contract: the ledger line holds `gate` and `open_items` as the trailer gave them; keys the trailer holds beyond those two are ignored

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/ledger_test.go, beside the existing ledger tests: a fake session whose merge commit ends 'AF-Run: {"gate":{"full":{"runs":3,"seconds":412.5,"reused":1},"task":{"runs":9,"seconds":95,"reused":0},"baseline_full_seconds":130.2,"last_full_seconds":141},"open_items":{"opened":{"awaits":1,"defect:minor":2},"closed":{},"passed_on":{},"reclassified":{}},"extra":1}': assert the ledger line's gate.full.runs == 3 and open_items.opened['defect:minor'] == 2 and no key extra; assert the stderr line contains '3 full', '412.5', '1 reused' and '3 opened'

criteria.condition: a package has landed and its merge commit has no `AF-Run:` trailer, or the trailer's value is not one JSON object
criteria.action: count the package as landed and warn
criteria.contract: the ledger line has outcome `landed` and neither `gate` nor `open_items`; `warnings` holds one `trailer_missing` entry naming the commit; the loop goes on

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers; an in-memory issuex.Client, added to those helpers, that records every call and can be told to fail one
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/ledger_test.go, a table over a merge commit {with no trailer, with 'AF-Run: not json', with 'AF-Run: [1]'}: assert outcome 'landed', the two keys absent, codes(warnings) == ['trailer_missing'] and the next package's session started

execution_paths.title: A package lands with an unlabelled issue and a trailer, and specrun files both

steps.action: runs `specrun` with a forge token in the environment
creates the labels of the scheme the repository lacks, then starts the session for the next package
implements the package, opens one issue with its labels and one without, and asks speca for the gate report
answers `--gate-report` with the counts the session copies into the `AF-Run:` trailer of the merge commit
checks the landing, lists the package's open issues and makes the unlabelled one a deviation, with a comment
reads the trailer and writes the ledger line with the gate and open-item counts

real_components: the fake claude as a real process
the label rules against the in-memory issuex client

a fake session that lands package 01 with a merge commit ending in an AF-Run trailer and leaves two open issues on the forge: one with af:defect, af:severity-minor and af:from-01, one titled '01_name: no caller' with no label
end_state: the forge holds every label of the scheme
the unlabelled issue carries af:deviation and af:from-01 and one comment naming the rule and the base commit
the ledger line of 01 holds the trailer's gate and open_items objects
